info.title: RECAVO API
info.description: REST JSON API under `/api/v1` (OpenAPI 3.1). Generated from the live Fastify route table plus curated overlays (`npm run openapi:export`). Conventions — cursor pagination, filter allow-lists, problem+json errors, and `x-request-id` on every response — are documented in `documents/api-conventions.md`. Human index: `/docs`.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token (or legacy session cookie on browser clients).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page `nextCursor`. Do not parse or construct client-side. Omit on the first page; do not reuse across different filter sets.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation / request id (UUIDv7). Echoes an inbound x-request-id when provided; otherwise generated. Matches problem+json `requestId` on errors.

field.description: Dotted path, header name, or `(body)` for body-level problems

message.description: Optional human-readable fallback for clients without a localisation map

type.description: Documentation URI for this problem class

title.description: Short, stable summary suitable for assistive announcements

detail.description: Optional actionable explanation (never present for INTERNAL)

requestId.description: Correlation id; matches the x-request-id response header

errors.description: Field-level validation problems (empty for non-validation errors)

NextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the list is exhausted. Pass as `cursor` on the subsequent request.

includesRefundedRevenue.description: When false, refunds are excluded from net and tracked as refundedMinor.

includesDisputedRevenue.description: When false, open disputes/chargebacks are excluded from net and tracked as disputedMinor (RECA-439).

linkedRecordId.description: Linked record (vehicle/pet/etc.) for this booking (RECA-90). Required when the service has `requiresLinkedRecord` or the active definition has `settings.requireForBooking`. Soft-archiving the record never clears this id — historical bookings remain readable via GET …/linked-records/{recordId}.

attendees.description: Booking attendees (RECA-111). lead_pays_party requires exactly two: one lead customer and one guest name with customerId null (guest is not a portal customer).

applicablePolicyDocumentIds.description: Map of policy type → policy_documents.id effective at booking create (RECA-67). At least `cancellation` is set when a published cancellation policy exists.

slotToken.description: HMAC-signed, expiring quote token; revalidated on hold/book.

preferredChannel.description: Preferred contact channel. Create/update reject `sms` until SMS delivery ships (RECA-468 / ADR 0018); historical rows may still store `sms`. Writable values: `email` | `phone` | `none`.

tags.description: Legacy denormalised string tags on create/update. Prefer customer-tags catalogue + assignments (RECA-78) for segmentation/filter.

requireForBooking.description: When true, booking create rejects a missing linkedRecordId even if the service does not set requiresLinkedRecord (RECA-90).

status.description: Soft-archive only. Archived records stay readable for booking history and keep booking.linkedRecordId intact (RECA-90).

depositMinor.description: Offline/manual deposit amount only. Never charged, held, or included in booking ServiceSnapshot / PaymentIntent amounts (RECA-467 / ADR 0018). Create/update reject values > 0 until an online deposit charge path ships; historical rows may still store a positive value. Writable values: omit | null | 0.

requiresLinkedRecord.description: When true, booking create requires an active linkedRecordId for the lead customer (OR with definition settings.requireForBooking; RECA-90).

packageId.description: Sellable package for package-checkout payments; null for booking payments.

taxTreatment.description: Tax treatment snapshotted at purchase (RECA-142 / ADR 0017; VAT registration only)

documentKind.description: Connect customer documents are receipts only at launch (ADR 0017)

objectKey.description: Non-guessable business-prefixed object storage key (never log file bytes).

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest registered on upload complete (RECA-82).

ownerType.description: Optional provenance for ACL hooks (RECA-83): customer|booking|linked_record|business.

deletedAt.description: Set when status=deleted after retention soft-delete (RECA-83).

BusinessSummary.description: Business the authenticated user has an active membership in.

BusinessConfiguration.description: Business settings: terminology, booking, tax, retention and legal address.

locationScopeIds.description: null = access to all locations; otherwise the restricted set.

eligibleServiceIds.description: Empty = credits usable on all services.

CreditBalance.description: Balance derived from the append-only credit ledger. `available` is spendable.
